Takako Honda (Japanese: 本田貴子 Honda Takako) is a Japanese voice actress for and . 

==Biography==
Honda was born on August 14, 1972, in , , and became a voice actress as an adult. She joined during the ninth movie, where she voiced Meredith. Her most notable role in that work, however, is the evil Pokémon Hunter J in . Honda is currently affiliated with Office Osawa.
